clue.text: Give lots of time for courses

clue.text: Small cat is gloomy

clue.text: Travelled on horseback, hugging a French lake, making circle

clue.text: Make bigger space with lager ordered

clue.text: Charm a smuggler with last place in boat

clue.text: Tick found around very big desert is bloodsucker

clue.text: Roughly, allowance is split

parts.note: C is short for circa, roughly
leave is an allowance, as of time off work

clue.text: Do answer father with love

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest

clue.text: Nightingale, perhaps, tires from flying
